what: asks 10, 12, 13 — the Free City trio. SHIZUOKA, founded by Japan (p1), captured by player 0 on turn 112, revolted to the Free Cities seat (player 62) on turn 115 and was watched to turn 124. Happiness values are GameInfo.Happinesses indices: 0 REVOLT, 1 UNREST, 2 UNHAPPY, 3 DISPLEASED, 4 CONTENT, 5 HAPPY, 6 ECSTATIC.

reads: city:ChangeLoyalty(-10) cannot make a Free City - it moves the loyalty STOCK and the pressure stays positive. A CAPTURE does it: the captured city came up at loyalty 50/100 with loyaltyPerTurn -20.27, and flipped on the third turn after the capture (112 captured, 115 free).

a Free City keeps the full amenity NEED of its population (5 for pop 9, the same as any city) and loses almost all supply: amenities 0-2 against 5 needed, tier UNREST(1)/UNHAPPY(2) every turn of the watch. GetAmenitiesFromLuxuries stays 2, so the 0-1 total carries negative terms the per-source getters do not name. It never reached REVOLT(0) in ten turns.

the Free City's city-centre defence strength is a FLAT 72 for every turn of the watch - HIGHER than the same city under its human captor (43) and higher than under Japan with walls (53/59). The Free Cities seat gets a defence floor of its own; it is not the owner's civ strength. Walls did NOT come back (walls false, outerMax 0 throughout), so the 72 is not a walls bonus.
the centre's garrison damage healed 40 -> 20 -> 8 -> 0 over turns 115-118 (20, then 12, then 8): a Free City heals its centre like any city, not instantly
TWO Man-At-Arms exist on the flip turn itself, on the tiles either side of the centre (21:21 and 21:23), with brand-new unit ids - granted by the revolt, not produced

a third free unit, a Crossbowman, appears at 21:23 on turn 120 - five turns after the flip - while the city's build queue held BUILDING_CATHEDRAL the whole time. The defenders are GRANTS on a cadence, not production.
the Free City's build queue only ever held BUILDINGS - Monument, Granary, then Cathedral for seven turns. It trained no unit in ten turns.

YES, it strikes. Japan's UNIT_ARCHER#3276817 stood adjacent at 22:22 on turn 116 with 73 damage (it was undamaged at 22:21 the turn before), and Free City MAN_AT_ARMS#65536 was gone while #131073 carried 15 damage. By turn 117 both Man-At-Arms were dead. The Free City attacked the units standing next to it and traded both its starting defenders away inside two turns.

spy: UNIT_SPY#3604500 bought in Nidaros for 445 gold (a TRAINED unit, not socket-spawned)
reads: ask 10 is CLOSED and the answer is NO. The target list names every city of every major AND every city-state, the spy owner's own cities included (Nidaros, Stavanger), but the Free City at 21:22 (plot 1341) is absent. A Free City is not spy ground.

the Free City's own loyalty resets to 100/100 on the flip and then falls again at -9 or -10 per turn: 100 (t115), 90, 81, 72, 63, 54, 45, 36, 27, 18 (t124). It is being pulled back toward Japan; a Free City is not a stable seat.

spyTargets: UnitManager.GetOperationTargets(spy, UnitOperationTypes.SPY_TRAVEL_NEW_CITY) returns ONE key (1933683541) holding a flat list of PLOT INDICES, not city ids
grants: Players[0]:GetTreasury():SetGoldBalance(v) and Players[0]:GetCulture():SetCivic(idx, true) both work in GameCore; HasCivic only reads true on the NEXT tuner call

reads: the Spy purchase cost exactly 445 gold (3000 -> 2555), the number scene G's formula predicted from the city's 112 production cost: floor(4*112/5)*5 = 445
